live_evidence.fact: Path is required as one-or-more strings and is defined in prose as ordered ancestry identities.
Scope Unit structural_level is required, one int, childless, nonnegative, with sole-derivation prose.
Package structural_level has the same contract and sole-derivation prose.
Existing CFEL provides non-Project single-parent constraints, a link-guarded child = parent + 1 equation, and Project root level 0.
Existing CFEL provides the analogous Package equation and Implementation root level 0.

candidate_extension.name: Declare relation-derived Property provenance

minimum_grammar.p: a logical Property path declared by the Claim bearer

exact_rule_text: DERIVED_FROM(p, R) declares p a relation-derived Property. A supplied or persisted p value is not an independent authored input or override and does not establish correctness by itself.

The effective p value must satisfy every applicable governing CFEL equation for p whose graph source is R. The equation's declared constants and kind-qualified root selections remain part of that equation; DERIVED_FROM does not add a field, a relation, a root, a fallback, or a new equation.

If the selected effective MODEL has no complete applicable governing equation for p, evaluation is invalid. If a stored/cache representation exists, it must equal the equation result and is only a representation, not an additional source.
DERIVED_FROM reads existing R facts and equations only. It does not write p, materialize a value, persist a cache, traverse an unbounded path, or prove acyclicity.

reusability.why_not_path: Path also needs ordered root-to-target identity sequence semantics. DERIVED_FROM alone proves only provenance, so using it to delete the Path meaning would lose a constraint.

claim_rewrites.subject: Scope Unit.structural_level
claim_rewrites.preserves: Required one nonnegative integer/no dependents plus the claim that containment, rather than an independently authored value, determines the effective level.
claim_rewrites.counterexample_rejected: An authored child level 99 with a parent level 0 fails the existing equation; an authored child level 1 would satisfy equality alone, but DERIVED_FROM rejects it as an independent input.

claim_rewrites.subject: Package.structural_level
claim_rewrites.preserves: Required one nonnegative integer/no dependents plus containment-only provenance.
claim_rewrites.counterexample_rejected: A cached child value may be retained only when it equals the governing equation result; it cannot be an override or a second source.

claim_rewrites.subject: Scope Unit.Path
claim_rewrites.reason: The live packet has no sequence/ancestry operator. A relation-derived provenance assertion cannot ensure that values are Scope Unit identities, ordered root-to-target, complete, or aligned with containment. Reintroducing a recursive path operator would exceed the withdrawn path-rule boundary and has only this consumer.

non_goals: No recursive relation-path, parent(), ANCESTORS, or sequence-index grammar.
No new binding, Property field, root instance, stored-value policy, or acyclicity assertion.
No claim that root zero and parent increment alone prove non-authored provenance.
implementation_gates: Resolve the selected effective MODEL's applicable equations before evaluating DERIVED_FROM.
Define cache/persisted representation equality without treating the representation as an authored value source.
Reject missing or conflicting applicable equations rather than silently accepting a Property value.
